text:
Tarik Skubal to face former team Tigers in first matchup since Dodgers trade
LAX Leader
Los Angeles Dodgers starting pitcher Tarik Skubal will pitch against his former team, the Detroit Tigers, on Friday, August 28. Dave Roberts announced the news as Skubal’s turn in the rotation comes during a road trip to Detroit, where he played for his entire career before joining the Dodgers.
The decision follows an emotional period for Skubal after leaving the only team he had known until joining Los Angeles. Despite questions about whether he would take the mound against his beloved former club, Skubal is set to start at Comerica Park.
During his exit press conference with the Tigers, Skubal paused to collect himself and showed visible emotion as he addressed reporters. “It’s tough,” he said, his voice cracking. “I love all those guys in there. They’re some of my best friends.”
Skubal acknowledged that facing Detroit would be challenging given his history with the franchise. He said, “I’m very appreciative of all the things the Tigers did for me. Drafting me in 2018, giving a kid a chance out of a small school, and giving me every resource to use. Everything has always been at my disposal.
“They’ve always had answers and a plan for me, so yeah — I feel like I’ve experienced a lot and gone through a lot of failure early in my career, and this club never stopped believing in me.
“They kept throwing me back out there every fifth day when I probably didn’t deserve it. That’s something I’ll never take for granted.”
Though it remains a regular-season game on paper, Friday’s matchup represents more than just another start for both Skubal and his new team.
